tagline: Empowering digital transformation through AI-integrated PLM and CAD solutions

risks.title: Cyberattacks or data breaches
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in the 10-K, with a dedicated approach (Zero Trust, NIST, OWASP). Language is strong ('mitigate all security threats'). Governance is strengthened, indicating an existential risk. Highly weighted category.

risks.title: Dependence on third-party suppliers
risks.score_rationale: The VRM program is detailed, with strict contractual requirements. Repeated mention of risks related to external access. Cautious language ('manage risk'). Major operational risk but not existential.

risks.title: Cybersecurity incident management
risks.score_rationale: Incident response policy described in detail, compliant with NIST 800-61, with regular testing. Emphasis on response indicates a real and active risk. Less severe than the primary threat.

risks.title: Foreign exchange risks
risks.score_rationale: 50% of revenue in foreign currencies, impacting reported results. Mentioned in MD&A, not in operational risks. Neutral language ('slight tailwind'). Moderate, well-managed risk.

risks.title: Concentration of R&D in India
risks.score_rationale: 267k sq ft of R&D space in India, representing 30% of total facilities. Not explicitly mentioned as a direct risk, but strong operational implication. Implied geopolitical or logistical risk. Moderately weighted category.

risks.title: Sale of Kepware and ThingWorx businesses
risks.score_rationale: Announced in MD&A, impacting strategy and cash flows. Considered strategic, but with uncertainty around closing and achievement of objectives. Transition and valuation risk.

ai_positioning.summary: PTC does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K filing. The information provided focuses primarily on financial aspects, acquisitions, and company operations, without addressing emerging technologies such as AI.
